versions.localizedDescription:
This version introduces 5 new features:

- Tweak Load Order Controller: Drag-to-reorder injected tweaks with real-time validation. Detects ordering conflicts (e.g., a tweak loaded before its dependency) and offers one-tap Auto-fix via topological sort. Substrate/ElleKit/libsubstrate automatically moved to position 0.

- Tweak Dependency Auto-Resolver: When importing or adding a tweak, automatically scans its Mach-O LC_LOAD_DYLIB entries and detects missing dependencies (e.g., CydiaSubstrate). Offers one-tap resolution: Inject ElleKit, Find on disk, or Skip. Re-scan button to re-check all added tweaks.

- Tweak Folders: Organize tweaks into user-created folders under Documents/App/Tweaks/. Smart Folders (All Tweaks, Dylibs Only, Debs Only, Recently Added) for quick filtering. Move tweaks between folders via swipe or menu. Folder-aware injection picker with drill-down navigation.

- Per-App Update Preferences: Control update behavior per app: Auto-Update (auto-download when update detected), Notify (show in updates list, default), or Ignore (hide entirely). Version-specific ignore (auto-clears when newer version appears). Global default configurable in Settings.

- Background Maintenance Task: New BGProcessingTask that runs every 6/12/24 hours. 5-phase pipeline: Source Refresh, Update Detection, Auto-Update (triggers per-app auto-update downloads), Stale Download Cleanup (removes IPAs older than 30 days), Certificate Expiry Check (notifies about certs expiring within 7 days). Detailed phase-by-phase log viewer.

Also includes:
- Fixed progress bar rendering black on light theme
- Fixed .framework/.bundle/.appex showing as folders in Tweak Library
- Fixed Available Tweaks conflict with Injected Tweaks section
- Update check now fetches sources automatically if not already fetched
- Reduced foreground update check throttle from 5 minutes to 2 minutes
- MachOReadLinkedDylibs() read-only ObjC function for Mach-O parsing
- 123 new localization keys

This version introduces:

- Animated splash launch screen with theme sync
- Adaptive splash for both light and dark modes
- Accent color reflected in splash screen glow, shimmer and branding
- Seamless storyboard-to-SwiftUI transition with zero flash
- Update checker with badge notifications and background refresh
- Pull-to-refresh in Library view
- Dark theme persistence fix on app restart
- Update All button for bulk app updates
- Smart update deduplication across sources
- Stale update cleanup when deleting apps
- Patch notes viewer on About page
- Rebranded to C0st1 with custom bundle ID (com.c0st1.ksign)
- Removed donations, Telegram, and Discord from settings
- Removed developer repo from default sources
- GitHub Repository and About (GitHub profile) links in settings
